races.title: Overlander Fishery Lane Novice Hurdle
races.verdict: BARTHOLOMEW was notably progressive in 3 juvenile hurdles last season, signing off with a fine second in a Punchestown Grade 1 in the spring. A recent spin on the Flat ought to have put him spot on for this and he's likely to take some stopping. That said, Willie Mullins' Love Me Tender impressed when bolting up in a race that's working out well and he's an obvious danger. Golden Handshake may emerge best of the others. BARTHOLOMEW LOVE ME TENDER (GER) GOLDEN HANDSHAKE
races.bettingForecast: Love Me Tender (1/2), Bunker Buster (4/1), Bartholomew (9/2), Darby O'gill (12/1), Golden Handshake (14/1)

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: MINELLA MACHINE looked a useful prospect when off the mark in bumpers last season and this costly point recruit is taken to continue the stable’s fine recent record in this race, with fellow expensive pointing purchase Coq Noir feared most now hurdling and likely to leave his sole bumper effort well behind, while unbeaten bumper performer Adaboy Mushy must also enter calculations. MINELLA MACHINE (IRE) COQ NOIR (FR) ADABOY MUSHY (IRE)
